notes.title: Update (August 4th)
notes.content:
Update to specifications for entering full screen mode. 
The specification for entering full screen mode has been changed to the window mode full screen size.

Hints for phase progression added.
A feature displaying in dialog form hints for progressing to the next phase have been added.
